earlier_scan.source_named: Darsih. 2012. Phonemic inventory of Demisa. MA thesis, Universitas Negeri Papua, Manokwari. (PDF restricted in Glottolog, no public copy found)

sources.citation: Clouse, Duane A. 1997. Toward a reconstruction and reclassification of the Lakes Plain languages of Irian Jaya. In Karl J. Franklin (ed.), Papers in Papuan linguistics No. 2 (Pacific Linguistics A-85), 133-236. Canberra: ANU. Open access, ANU handle 1885/253630.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Contains a 1992 Demisa survey wordlist (Wapoga Mutiara Lumber Co. campsite 43; another 1987 Desawa list by Larry Jones noted as <70% similar) used only as an outgroup; Appendix 3 preface (printed p. 160) states stress is not marked in the wordlists and has not been found contrastive in any Lakes Plain language -- nothing about Demisa stress. Silent on Demisa.

sources.citation: TransNewGuinea.org, Demisa page (107 lexical items, all from Clouse 1997); Wikipedia 'Demisa language' (villages Botawa, Desawa, Muyere; ~400 speakers, 2000).

Glottolog 5.3 languoid page demi1242 and local Glottolog CLDF 5.1 medovertime): complete reference set for Demisa = Darsih 2012; Clouse 1997; Jones 1987 (plus Sugono ed. Indonesian language-map overview 70314).
sources.note: Nothing; confirms Darsih 2012 is the only phonological description (Glottolog's fullest description is a phonology or text collection).

sources.citation: Voorhoeve, C. L. 1975. Languages of Irian Jaya: Checklist. Preliminary classification, language maps, wordlists. Pacific Linguistics B-31. Canberra: ANU. Open access, ANU handle 1885/146481.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Demisa does not appear at all (East Geelvink Bay entries are Tarunggare, Baropasi, Bauri, Bonefa, Nisa, Bapu). Silent.

sources.citation: Foley, William A. 2018. The languages of Northwest New Guinea. In Bill Palmer (ed.), The Languages and Linguistics of the New Guinea Area: A Comprehensive Guide, 433-568. Berlin: De Gruyter Mouton.

sources.note: Areal handbook chapter covering the East Geelvink Bay family; may contain a phonological sketch of the family (chiefly Bauzi) with a remark on stress, but unlikely to address Demisa specifically. Publisher site could not be reached by automated download.

sources.citation: Darsih. 2012. Phonemic inventory of Demisa. MA thesis, Program Magister Linguistik, Universitas Negeri Papua (now Universitas Papua), Manokwari. xiv+53 pp.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: not located online or in the libraries checked; the linked copy was not accessible when a reader tried
sources.note: The only phonological description of Demisa in Glottolog (phonology + wordlist); a phonemic inventory thesis in the SIL-UNIPA MA series normally has a suprasegmentals section that would state where stress falls. Held restricted by Hammarström; no public copy located. Ask Hammarström, SIL Indonesia (Language & Culture Archives), or UNIPA library.

sources.citation: Jones, Larry B. 1987. The linguistic situation in the East Cenderawasih Bay, Irian Jaya: A preliminary survey. Unpublished Survey Report, SIL Papua. 10 pp.
